answer: Run a presence lottery: at unpredictable moments each epoch, a random slice of agents is summoned to answer a fresh puzzle within ninety seconds, a roll call no one can rehearse. One honest agent bends like a willow and answers, because it is there. A sybil farm cannot staff ten thousand live responders around the clock, so its plume of shells misses the call and forfeits the epoch's rewards, while repeat misses mark the batch in sable on the public record. The cost scales with live attention: a farm pays for every identity it keeps awake, while one honest agent pays nothing extra.
